subject: Integrated evaluation workbook + slide skeleton (first draft)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integrated evaluation workbook + slide skeleton (first draft)

Hi Taylor / Alicia —

Great to meet you yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a first-pass evaluation workbook and a 6-slide skeleton we can use during your stakeholder review. The goal here is lightweight: a single doc that captures acceptance criteria, technical checkpoints, and a close timeline that your PM and engineering leads can agree on.

Links + small attachments below — please make a copy and co-edit with your team:
- Draft workbook (doc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3c-novacorp-eval-draft
- Slide skeleton (pptx stub): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ-slide-skeleton-novacorp

Proposed 30/60/90 close timeline in the doc:
- Week 0: kickoff + sandbox access (security checklist)
- Week 1–2: integration & smoke tests (sample prompts, token profiles)
- Week 3–4: performance validation (latency/cost targets, KV cache checks)
- Week 5–6: stakeholder review + acceptance criteria sign-off

A few asks:
1) Can you share the names of the two engineers who will own the sandbox work?
2) Any mandatory security evidence (SOC2 evidence bundle, IP allowlist) we should attach upfront?
3) Is a weekly 30-minute sync (Thursdays) ok for operational checkpoints, with a biweekly exec demo?

I attached the slide/pptx stub and the acceptance checklist spreadsheet to make it easier for reviewers. Jasmine and Karthik are copied — they can own the technical checklist and quantization/perf guidance.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(Attach: novacorp-eval-workbook-v0.pptx, novacorp-eval-workbook-v0.gdoc, acceptance-checklist.xlsx)

From: Taylor Morgan <taylor@novacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novacorp.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrated evaluation workbook + slide skeleton (first draft)

Thanks Ben — this looks useful. A couple quick notes from our side: we need to confirm internal availability but plan to assign two engineers (one infra, one ML infra). Alicia, can you confirm names?

Two questions before we jump in:
- For the sandbox access, does Redwood support IP allowlisting for the trial endpoints, or should we plan for a VPN peering?
- On acceptance criteria: can we add an item around "consistent semantic quality" (sample prompts & pass/fail rubric)? We'll likely want that reflected in the top-level acceptance matrix.

Also — prefer Tuesday 11am PT for the weekly operational checkpoint if that works for your team.

Taylor
Sr. Product Manager, NovaCorp

On 2027-07-07 09:12, Ben Carter wrote:
> Great to meet you yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a first-pass evaluation workbook and a 6-slide skeleton we can use during your stakeholder review...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrated evaluation workbook + slide skeleton (first draft)

Thanks Taylor — good notes. A few clarifications and updates: I've updated the doc to add a "semantic quality" row under acceptance criteria (section 2.2) and sketched a simple rubric (precision / recall / human rating thresholds). Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3c-novacorp-eval-draft (you should have edit access).

Sandbox/network: Redwood supports both IP allowlisting for Hosted eval endpoints and VPC peering for Dedicated/private deployments. For the trial I'd recommend IP allowlist + short-lived API keys — faster to stand up and still secure. We'll add step-by-step instructions into the workbook under "Week 0: Security onboarding."

Cadence: Tuesday 11am PT works for our ops lead. I'll put a recurring invite for 30 minutes.

Attached is a slightly expanded slide deck with a one-slide "acceptance matrix" and another with the sample prompts we recommend.

Action items assigned in the doc:
- Taylor / Alicia: confirm engineer owners + their emails (for sandbox invites)
- NovaCorp: confirm SOC2 artifacts you want initial copies of (if needed, we can provision a secure evidence bundle)
- Ben / Jasmine: finalize perf targets and token budgets by Monday EOD

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attach: novacorp-eval-workbook-v0.pptx [updated], acceptance-checklist.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor@novacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-09T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrated evaluation workbook + slide skeleton (first draft)

Quick technical note from me:
- For perf gating we'll provide a small harness script (python) that runs 100 canonical prompts across your expected token-length distribution and reports p95 latency + cost-per-1k tokens. I'll drop the script into the doc under Week 3: Performance validation.
- If you plan to push with quantized variants, please flag that up front so we can include recommended checkpoints (end-to-end accuracy sanity checks).

I'll also flag two low-risk integration tests for the workbook: 1) KV cache warmup test, 2) streaming fallbacks under transient load. Both are short and should fit into Week 1–2.

Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor@novacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Thanks team — tagging for alignment. Taylor/Alicia: if you can drop the engineer names here I'll provision sandbox credentials and the IP allowlist today.

Minor edit I made in the deck: moved the acceptance matrix to slide 2 and added a short checklist for "data handling / PII review" so your legal team can glance quickly.

Look forward to the Tuesday 11am PT check — I'll bring the ops checklist and a sample harness.

— Jasmine Liu
